utterances.text: Well, I really can't do that. As I told you a minute ago, it's a large area and it's built up. There are a lot of buildings there. You know what Alipasino Polje looked like. It's difficult to do that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree with me that the northern tip of this "8" symbol is the place where one of the shells landed, or was there some other sketch? In other words, the on-site investigation report, does that also have a sketch attached?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think that this does exist. A crime technician measured the distance from the hard objects. So I think that the shells fell at a certain distance. The 120 one that we hadn't dealt with, I think it fell on the roof or something like that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you now mark the Institute for Blind Children? Not the name; the building itself. Where is it, exactly? And you can also use the paper map, if you wish. It says here "Zavod," the "Institute," but I think that the building is between those letters and where it says "Slepu Deca" [phoen], "Blind Children."

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just a moment, please. I think it is this building here [marks]. Somewhere around here, roughly. It would be there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Why would it be so far away from the lettering that says "Institute for Blind Children"? Isn't it underneath the "D," the letter D, the building underneath the letter D?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: Which "D," "Nedzarici"?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: No, "Zavod Slepu Deca." Do you see where it says that, the "Institute for Blind Children"? Do you see that?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't see that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: To the north of what you marked just now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The quality maybe is not very well, Mr. Karadzic. I think it's a scanned copy from the copy again.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Here it is. I do apologise. [Marks]. This is the institute, so we should erase what I first drew. I'm going to mark it with a Z.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Please, what is that big building further north from the "Zavod" or institute?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: That is the former "Oslobodjenje" building. It's a hotel now, Crowne Plaza.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you put a circle around that as well?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]. I'm going to mark it with "O," "Oslobodjenje." Is that all right?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And these two buildings that look like a Y, what is that?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: You're referring to this over here? Those are student dormitories.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you put a circle around them as well?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: "SD," "Studentski Domovi," [phoen] "Student Dormitories."

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us where the line of separation was here?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know exactly. But I will tell you that the Student Dormitories were held by the members of the Army of Bosnia-Herzegovina. The Institute for Blind Children was held by the Army of Republika Srpska, and the building of "Oslobodjenje" was under the control of the Army of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Now we're going to go back to this. Thank you very much. It would be a good thing if we could mark 1, 2 and 3, where they fell, but they did fall within this circle that you marked here; right? Can you put some marking there for that circle? Can you perhaps put an "I" as in "Impact"?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: Impact, okay [marks]. Should I sign this?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Please do, the date and your signature.

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: That is admitted.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D746, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we now agree that this report says that an 82-millimetre mortar shell fell - page 2 of this report: "On the basis of the general-form traces of the fragmented part of this shell and the destruction on the buildings in the surrounding area, it can be established that what fell on the site was a mortar shell of 82-millimetre calibre that was fired from a direction that was somewhat to the north in relation to the west."

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: We did not have the text that was being read out.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Your colleague said that this was mildly to the north-west; right?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: Precisely.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we have that returned, I mean the document, 746, D746.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that in relation to this point of impact, the Institute for Blind Children is to the south-west, not the north-west?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the basis of the map, I do agree.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you agree that the "Oslobodjenje" building and the Student Dormitories, especially the one that is further to the north, are a bit to the north-west in relation to the point of impact?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: I would say that it's purely to the west. It's north-west. The "Oslobodjenje" building further to the west, and the Student Dormitories are the north-west, if we can put it that way.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you please draw a line from the Student -- or, rather, no, from the Institute of Blind Children to the point of impact horizontally, or, rather, no, a straight line?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And then from the Student Dormitories, from the upper student dormitory, the one to the north, to the point of impact?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: I am going to draw a line from the Institute for Blind Children [marks]. Do you want me to use a different colour when marking this other one?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Please, red.

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]. However, I have to say that we did not exactly locate the point of impact. However, there is this circle that we marked as impact place.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The building of the Student Dormitories, it cannot really be seen very well, but you know where it is. It's below this smear, as it were.

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: Should I use green?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: That's all right. It's below the blot, and then the other one --

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, here it is.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you draw that?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes [marks].

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. This doesn't have to be admitted separately; right?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We'll keep it as is.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] For the transcript, the blue line denotes the direction from the Institute for Blind Children to the zone of impact, and then the red, "Oslobodjenje," and the green, the building of the Student Dormitories, or, rather, the northern one --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The interpreter did not hear the end of the sentence. There is too much background noise.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Do you agree that your colleague did not establish the azimuth; rather, he said, by way of a description, that it's west and then a bit further to the north in relation to pure west? Right?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: I agree that's what the late Stankov wrote.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you know why they did not take any photographs, and why did they not ensure that there were photographs and sketches of this location?

utterances.speaker: MIRZA SABLJICA [Resumed]
utterances.text: Believe me, I don't know. We are going back to a case where there is not sufficient documentation with regard to the sniper nest that I spoke of yesterday.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: That will be it for today, Mr. Karadzic. We'll resume tomorrow at 9.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
